ctx.x: But it was an experience, and we also did the "Jolson Story" there, and did a couple of things on Rita Hayworth -- so actually, you see, what was happening was that I would be involved in the musicals, especially, because the guys couldn't keep time because they were legit. But my thing to do all the time was to play the traps, and to catch what they were doing.

So it was during the time I was there that I did a lot of things with Mel Powell, and Benny Goodman came over and asked -- he wanted me to do some concerts with him, and so I told him he had to ask Morris Stoloff. Well, you know, if a guy's on the staff at the studio, and Benny Goodman comes in and requests him, then the whole studio is just up in the air, you know, because the King of Swing wants one of our musicians out of our band.

And so they left me off for a couple of weeks and I did concerts you know, here on the coast. It was Benny, Red Norva Nobel, Red Callendar, and Mel Powell. So we did at the Shrine Auditorium, we did at Long Beach, and San Bernardino and I forget where else.
